title: Jesus Teaches About Impurity and Korban
description: The Pharisees and the scribes from Jerusalem confront Jesus because his disciples eat with unwashed hands. Jesus answers by quoting Isaiah about hypocrites who honor God with their lips, and he accuses them of setting aside God's command in favor of human tradition. He uses the example of Korban, where people declare property as a gift to God so they can avoid helping their parents. To the crowd he explains that it is not what enters a person from outside that makes them unclean, but what comes out of the heart—evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, and more. In this way he declares all food clean.
